rca_of_issue: Original prod issue: Emergent snapshots deployment secrets at first deploy — MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID added to backend/.env after first deploy was not on the running deployed server, so _sms_available() returned False and OTPs were silently not sent. v5 fix RCA-verified: (1) MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID has a built-in default '61baece18e964726da04e8c5' so the template is always defined; (2) _sms_available() effectively only needs MSG91_AUTHKEY (which is a real secret and must be set); (3) /api/health now publicly lists env_keys_missing and warnings so operators can see 'MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID not set — using built-in default' immediately after Redeploy without needing admin auth; (4) The admin SMS tab's SERVER ENVIRONMENT card gives the same info in the UI. Subprocess simulation with MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID unset confirms preflight_ok=true, so operators can simply Redeploy the deployed server and OTPs will resume even before someone remembers to also set MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID in Deployments → Secrets. Mitigation confirmed complete.
